summary.headline: Astrological Judgments on Journeys
summary.text: Astrological judgments on travel and livelihood: Mars, the Moon, the ascendant lord, the ninth house, and the lords of Mars’s triplicity determine whether journeys bring prosperity, loss, foreign residence, or quiet at home. The text also considers planetary application, commixture, concord, aspects, houses, terms, angles, and the Moon on the third day after birth.
